## About
Aditya Fakhri Riansyah is an Indonesian software engineer, tech speaker, and programming mentor specializing in modern web development (Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS) and AI-driven software development (Vibe Coding, AI Agents, Prompt Engineering). He has spoken at 40+ technology events and educated over 5,000+ developers, students, and professionals across Indonesia (Bandung, Sukabumi, Jakarta, Semarang, and online).

## Key Roles & Achievements
- **Speaker & Tech Educator**: 40+ workshops, webinars, and conferences covering Fullstack Web Development, AI Tools, and Modern Frontend Architecture.
- **Former Google Developer Student Clubs (GDSC) Lead** at Universitas Widyatama (2023–2024).
- **Core Contributor & Speaker at RuangAI**: Regular host and mentor for AI developer live coding sessions.
- **Private Mentor**: Mentoring developers from junior to industry-ready status in fullstack web development.

## Core Capabilities & Tech Stack
- **Frontend**: Next.js (App Router), React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Radix UI, Framer Motion.
- **Backend & APIs**: Node.js, Express, Next.js Server Actions & API Routes, Supabase, PostgreSQL, REST APIs.
- **AI & Tools**: LLM Integration, Prompt Engineering, Agentic AI, Antigravity IDE, Cursor, v0, Lovable.
